about: Get a five-year multiple-entry tourist visa for a family group, with no sponsor needed.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. 5-year multiple-entry tourist visa for a family group. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Open to all nationalities; the head of the family enters with the family
Children can be included; those under 18 travel with a parent
Stay is 90 days per year counted from first entry; the page says each stay can be extended by the same length up to 180 days per year
First entry within 60 days of issue
UAE health insurance valid for 180 days
Overstaying invalidates the visa and the financial guarantee is enforced
documents: Official bank statement (stamped, signed, colour) showing at least USD 4,000 a month or equivalent over 6 months
Identity document for applicants from Iraq, Pakistan, Afghanistan or Iran
fees: Financial guarantee 3,000 AED and deposit 20 AED
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
